title: In the Hold
text: Drink for the duration of time your chosen wrestler is placed in a finisher or signature submission.

outcomes.label: They're in the hold — start the clock

title: Money in the Bank
text: Cash in your drinks and pass them onto someone else.

outcomes.label: Cash in — pass my drinks on

title: German Suplex
text: If a German suplex occurs on your chosen wrestler drink for 3 seconds.

title: Title Loss
text: If your chosen wrestler loses his title down your drink.

outcomes.label: They lost the title — I down it

title: Heel Turn
text: Drink for 5 seconds if a heel turn occurs.

title: Shenanigans
text: Drink for 3 seconds if any shenanigans occurs.

title: Face Turn
text: Drink for 5 seconds if a face turn occurs.

title: Product Placement
text: Take a drink for every shameless product placement ad.

title: Hit With a Finisher
text: If your chosen wrestler gets hit with a finisher drink for 5 seconds.

outcomes.label: Hit with a finisher — I drink 5s

title: Celebrity Spotted
text: Drink every time a celebrity is shown in the crowd.

title: Bladed
text: Down your drink if your chosen wrestler is cut open.

title: The Bloodline
text: Take a drink anytime The Bloodline is mentioned.

title: Divas on Screen
text: Drink anytime an attractive diva appears.

title: Danhausen
text: If Danhausen appears everyone drink.

title: Defeat
text: If your chosen wrestler loses drink for 5 seconds.

title: Spanish Announce Table Broken
text: Down your beer if the Spanish announcer table is broken.

title: Legendary Bloodline
text: If your chosen wrestler is from a legendary bloodline drink for 3 seconds.

title: Former World Champion
text: If your wrestler is a former world champion drink for 3 seconds.

title: Finisher Reversed
text: If your wrestlers finisher is reversed drink for 3 seconds.

title: Heel Turn
text: You pick a player of your choice to drink for 3 seconds.

title: Tag Team
text: Pick a friend to join your tag. Your next drink is doubled and passed onto someone else of your team's choice.

title: Papi and Dixie
text: Drink for 3 seconds if a wrestler appears with glasses (sunglasses count).

title: Jude
text: Jude drinks for 3 seconds if a bald wrestler appears.

title: Rouse
text: Rouse drinks for 3 seconds if an argument hand gesture occurs during the event.

title: Double Team
text: If you have this card and a double team move occurs give out two drinks to two players of your choice.

title: High Flying
text: If a high flying move is performed give out a two second drink.

title: Banger Theme
text: If your chosen wrestlers theme song is a banger you must drink for 5 seconds.

title: Real Name?
text: If you don't know your chosen wrestlers real name you must take a drink.

title: Vegas Reunion
text: If a wrestler appears that we met in Las Vegas or seen in a casino drink for 3 seconds.

title: Money in the Bank
text: If your chosen wrestler wins the Money in the Bank everyone else must drink for 5 seconds.

outcomes.label: My wrestler won it — everyone else drinks 5s

title: Botch!
text: Drink for 3 seconds if a botch occurs.

title: Two Count!
text: Drink every time there is a two count.

title: Table or Ladder!
text: Drink for 5 seconds if your wrestler is put through a table or ladder.

title: Small Package!
text: Down your drink for a small package or any type of roll up.

title: Ladder Leap!
text: Give out a 5 second drink if your wrestler jumps off a ladder.

title: Nip Up!
text: Take a drink for a nip up.

title: Mexican / Canadian Destroyer!
text: Drink for 3 seconds if your wrestler is hit by any sort of Mexican / Canadian destroyer.

title: 3 Amigos!
text: Drink for 3 amigos.

title: Briefcase Hug!
text: If your wrestler wins the Money in the Bank and finishes by hugging the referee with the briefcase choose someone to down their drink.

title: Hot Tag!
text: Drink for a hot tag.

title: Cash in Same Night!
text: Down your drink if your Money in the Bank winner cashes in the same night.

title: Hot Tag!
text: Hot tag! You can choose someone to tag in and give half of your drinking penalty too.

outcomes.label: Tag someone in — split my penalty

title: Rope Break!
text: Call rope break if your called upon for a drink and the drink will be passed onto the person on your left.

title: No Sell!
text: If someone gives you drinks use this card to no sell and give them the drinks in return.

title: You Are Cursed!
text: Play this card on somebody and they must take the next 3 drink punishments.

title: WWE Champion!
text: You are the champion! You can create one drinking rule that everyone must abide by for the event.

title: Title Match Penalty!
text: Your drinking penalties are doubled during title matches.

outcomes.label: Acknowledge — my penalties double in title matches

title: Pass the Penalty!
text: If you win a mini game your title match drinking penalty is passed onto the loser of the mini game.

outcomes.label: Pass my title match penalty on

title: Tag Team Throwdown
text: Pick a tag partner. You must go back and forth naming tag teams against two other players. The first team to fail or repeat loses.

title: Catchphrase Chaos
text: Take turns naming wrestler catchphrases. The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: Royal Rumble Royalty
text: Take turns naming Royal Rumble winners. The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: One Name Only
text: The players to your left and right will take turns against each other naming wrestlers with one name. The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: ECW Legends
text: Take turns naming ECW legends. The first person to fail or repeat loses.

outcomes.label: Loser downs their can and smashes it across their head

title: Wrestling Families
text: Take turns naming wrestlers from wrestling families (e.g. fathers & sons, brothers, cousins, etc.). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

outcomes.label: Loser drinks 1s per Bloodline member named

title: Deceased Wrestlers
text: Take turns naming deceased wrestlers. The first person to fail or repeat loses.

outcomes.label: Loser downs their can in memory of the dead

title: Wrestler Nicknames
text: Take turns naming wrestlers nicknames. The first person to fail or repeat loses.

outcomes.label: Loser drinks 1s per letter of their nickname

title: Non American Wrestlers
text: Take turns naming non American wrestlers (from any country outside the United States). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

outcomes.label: Loser drinks the flight time to that wrestler's country

title: Finishing Moves
text: Take turns naming wrestlers finishing moves (e.g. Stone Cold Stunner, RKO, Pedigree, Spear, etc). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: Elimination Chamber
text: Keep naming people who have participated in an Elimination Chamber match. Continue until only one player is left standing.

title: WCW & WWE Legends
text: Take turns naming wrestlers who have appeared in both WCW and WWE. The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: Match Stipulations
text: Take turns against the person to your left naming wrestling match stipulations (e.g. steel cage, TLC, Hell in a Cell, etc.). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: Wrestling Factions
text: Take turns naming wrestling factions (e.g. The Shield, Evolution, DX, etc.). If you fail or repeat, the player to your right has 30 seconds to name as many nWo members as they can.

outcomes.label: Loser drinks 1s per nWo member named

title: A-Z Wrestlers
text: Take turns naming wrestlers in alphabetical order (A–Z). Keep going until only one player is left. If you fail or repeat, you're out for this round.

title: Managers & General Managers
text: Take turns naming wrestling managers and general managers (e.g. Paul Heyman, Vickie Guerrero, Eric Bischoff, Adam Pearce, etc.). If you fail or repeat, the player to your right becomes your manager and decides how long you drink.

title: Money in the Bank Cash In
text: Just like a real cash in... Pick any player to drink for 5 seconds.

title: Reversal
text: Just like in the ring... you reversed a finisher! Pick any player to drink for 5 seconds.

title: Heel Turn
text: You've turned heel! Pick a friend to drink for 5 seconds.

title: Faction Formed
text: You and the players to your left and right have formed a faction! Pick any player to drink for 5 seconds.

title: WWE & TNA Crossovers
text: Take turns naming wrestlers who have been in both WWE and TNA. Keep going until one player is left.

title: Gimmicked Up
text: Take turns naming wrestlers with gimmicks (e.g. The Undertaker, Doink, Mankind, etc.). Keep going until one player is left.

title: Female Wrestlers
text: Take turns naming female wrestlers (past or present). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: ECW & WWE Double Duty
text: Take turns naming wrestlers who have wrestled in both ECW and WWE. Keep going until one player is left.

title: Submission Specialists
text: Take turns naming wrestler finisher or signature submissions (e.g. Sharpshooter, STF, Ankle Lock, etc.). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

outcomes.label: Loser taps out and downs their can

title: Masked Wrestlers
text: Take turns naming wrestlers who have worn a mask (past or present). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: Multiple Characters
text: Take turns naming wrestlers who have used two different characters or gimmicks (e.g. Kane/The Undertaker, Mankind/Cactus Jack, etc.). Keep going until there are two players left.

title: Black Wrestlers
text: Take turns naming Black wrestlers (past or present). Keep going until one player is left. Hot tag rule: the winner can save one player from drinking.

title: Kayfabe Relatives
text: Take turns naming kayfabe wrestling relatives (e.g. brothers, fathers, sons, cousins, etc.). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

outcomes.label: ...and picks a relative to drink with them

title: One on One With the Undertaker
text: Take turns naming The Undertaker's WrestleMania opponents. If you fail or repeat, you drink for the same number of seconds as the WrestleMania number of the last correct opponent mentioned.

title: Supernatural Characters
text: Take turns naming supernatural characters (in WWE or other wrestling). Keep going until one player is left.

outcomes.label: Winner may double the drinks for the loser of the next round

title: Wrestling Couples
text: Take turns with the person to your left naming wrestling couples (real life or kayfabe). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

outcomes.label: Loser picks a partner — both drink 5s

title: Bald Wrestlers
text: Take turns naming bald wrestlers (past or present). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: Asian Wrestlers
text: Take turns naming Asian wrestlers (past or present). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

outcomes.label: Loser does their best Japanese accent and drinks 5s

title: Attitude Era Wrestlers
text: Take turns naming Attitude Era wrestlers (1997 – 2002). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

outcomes.label: Loser downs their can in the name of the Attitude Era

title: Last Man Standing
text: Take turns naming former WWE / World Heavyweight champions (past or present). Keep going until there is one person left – the last man standing.

title: Cruiserweight Challenge
text: The person to your right has 15 seconds to name 8 former WWE Cruiserweight champions.

title: Nexus Roll Call
text: The person to your left has 10 seconds to name 5 members of Nexus.

title: Count Out
text: Count out! The person to your right drinks for 10 seconds.

title: 3 Count
text: 3 count! The person to your left drinks for 3 seconds.

title: Triple Company Challenge
text: Pick 3 opponents. Take turns naming wrestlers who have been in all three: TNA, WCW and WWE. The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: Title Roll Call
text: Take turns naming current and former WWE titles (singles, tag team, women's, and any other official titles). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: Slow Ref Count
text: The referee starts a slow count! The person to your right drinks for 5 seconds.

title: Commentary Call
text: Take turns naming current and former wrestling commentators (WWE, WCW, TNA, AEW, etc.). The first person to fail or repeat loses.

title: Weapons Challenge
text: The person to your left has 15 seconds to name 10 weapons used in wrestling.

title: Wrestling Companies
text: The person to your right and left must go back and forth naming wrestling companies (past & present).

title: You're Fired!
text: Whoever draws this card must drink for 5 seconds.

title: Wrestlers & Movies
text: Take turns going back and forth naming wrestlers and movies they have starred in.

title: Referee Rumble
text: The players to your left and right must take turns naming referees. The first person to lose must get a 3 count and drink for 3 seconds.

outcomes.label: Loser takes the 3 count and drinks 3s

title: 9 to 5
text: Take turns naming wrestlers who have another profession as their gimmick (e.g. cop, doctor, teacher, plumber, etc.). The first person to lose must drink for 8 seconds in the name of an 8-hour work shift.

title: Hart Family Challenge
text: The person to your left has 10 seconds to name 5 members of the Hart family.

title: Wrestler Name Game
text: Go back and forth naming wrestlers until one person is left. The next wrestler must begin with the last letter of the previous wrestler's name. Example: Jeff Hardy → the next wrestler must begin with H.

outcomes.label: Last standing dishes out 20s among the losers

title: Irish Wrestlers
text: Take turns naming Irish wrestlers. The first person to fail or repeat must drink for 3 seconds.

title: Wrestler Name Game Part 2
text: Go back and forth naming wrestlers until one person is left. The next wrestler must begin with the last letter of the previous wrestler's name.

outcomes.label: Last standing dishes out 20s among the losers

title: General Manager Mode
text: You are in General Manager mode. You may pick another player to drink for 3 seconds.

title: Taboo Tuesday
text: The group must vote on who drinks for 5 seconds. The person with the most votes must drink.

title: English Wrestlers
text: The persons to your left and right must take turns naming English wrestlers. The first person to fail or repeat must drink for 3 seconds.

title: WWE PPV Challenge
text: The person to your left has 20 seconds to name 10 WWE PPVs.

title: TNA PPV Challenge
text: The person to your right must name 3 TNA PPVs.

title: WCW PPV Challenge
text: You must name 3 WCW PPVs.

title: King of the Ring Winners
text: Take turns naming King of the Ring winners until one person is left. The last person standing is the King of the Ring and picks who drinks.

outcomes.label: King picks a player to drink 5s

title: Wrestlers You Would Beat
text: Take turns naming wrestlers you think you would beat in a fight. Continue until the majority of the group disagrees that you would win.

title: Botch!
text: Drink for 3 seconds.

title: Montreal Screw Job
text: Pick a player to drink for 3 seconds. If you pick yourself, you screwed yourself... and the drink is doubled and passed back onto you.

title: That's Not Going to Work For Me Brother
text: You get to skip the 3 drinks for this one as you refuse to do the job and pass it to the person to your left.

title: Burying Talent
text: The worst performer of the game so far must pay their dues and drink for 3 seconds.

title: Vacated Championship
text: Finish your drink and declare you can vacant.

title: Botchamania
text: You botched WrestleMania. Your drinking losses are doubled for the next 5 minutes.

outcomes.label: Start the 5 minutes — my drinks are doubled

title: Tribal Chief
text: You must refer to the person to your left as your Tribal Chief until you win a mini game. Anytime you call them by any other name you must drink.

title: The Shield
text: Pick two other players to take 4 drinks with you.

title: The Jobber
text: For the next 5 mini games you must take a drink.

title: Double Count Out
text: You and the person to your right must drink for 4 seconds.

title: Outside WWE
text: Name a wrestler who never wrestled in WWE.

outcomes.label: I named one — hand out 5 drinks

title: You Are Cursed
text: Danhausen picks someone to drink for 3 seconds.

title: Animal Instincts
text: Name 5 animal related wrestlers.

title: Legend Killer
text: The oldest person in the room must drink for 3 seconds.
